summary: This standards-track document defines GMPLS OSPF-TE extensions for Flexi-Grid Dense Wavelength Division Multiplexing networks. It follows the ITU-T flexible grid definitions in G.694.1 and G.872. The extensions let routers advertise the information needed for such optical networks.

eli5.summary: Light in fiber can be split into many colors, and with flexi-grid each color gets the width it needs. This helps routers share information about those colors.

questions: how does ospf-te support flexi-grid dwdm
what is a flexi-grid optical network
